profile.headline: Technical Program Manager | Implementation Manager | Financial Services | Healthcare | CCaaS & Conversational AI | Enterprise Delivery
profile.summary:
Implementation Manager and Technical Program Manager with 26 years of experience delivering enterprise contact center and IVR solutions for banking, healthcare, government, and utilities clients.
 
My career has been built on the vendor side — owning programs end-to-end across CCaaS and IVR platforms from requirements through go-live and post-production support. I've always been accountable to external client outcomes, not just internal delivery metrics.
 
My background covers IVR design and delivery, conversational AI, NLU implementations, and enterprise systems integration — across platforms like Cisco CVP, Avaya, and Genesys.
 
Open to full-time and contract opportunities in NJ, NYC, and remote. Feel free to connect.

positions.title: Lead Specialist / Engagement & Delivery Lead
positions.description:
Function: Technical Program Manager / Senior Implementation Manager
 
HCLTech acquired Nuance Enterprise Professional Services from Microsoft in 2025 — continuous employment from 2007 through 2026 across Nuance, Microsoft, and HCLTech

Served as a senior delivery lead on the IRS enterprise technology program — owning end-to-end delivery for assigned workstreams across Engineering, QA, Product, and federal stakeholders supporting 5M+ annual taxpayer interactions in a FedRAMP regulated environment
 
Drove scope decomposition, milestone tracking, dependency management, and risk mitigation across 4+ cross-functional teams — accelerating blocker resolution by 20–30% through structured escalation protocols and stakeholder alignment
 
Built Power BI KPI dashboard tracking program health, delivery milestones, release readiness, and compliance checkpoints — providing leadership with real-time data-driven visibility into program status and risks
 
Delivered agentic AI implementations using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Nuance MIX — designing NLU conversation flows, intent models, and enterprise system integrations for contact center modernization programs
positions.insights: Skills: Design Documents · Technical Solution Design · Interactive Voice Response (IVR) · Customer Service · Front-End Development · Debugging · Computer Science · Mentoring · Troubleshooting · Programming · Customer Requirements · Java · JavaServer Pages (JSP) · Project Management

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Project Lead
positions.description:
Function: Technical Program Manager / Senior Implementation Lead

Led end-to-end program delivery for the IRS enterprise technology program — coordinating across Engineering, QA, product managers, and federal stakeholders supporting 5M+ annual taxpayer interactions in a FedRAMP regulated environment
 
Drove scope definition, release governance, and stakeholder alignment across multi-year release cycles — delivering consistent on-time outcomes with zero-downtime go-lives
 
Established program governance standards and KPI tracking that reduced release variability by ~30% and provided leadership with real-time delivery visibility
 
Managed delivery across onshore and offshore teams in Pune, India — coordinating dependencies, removing blockers, and influencing alignment without direct authority
positions.insights: Skills: Java · JavaServer Pages (JSP) · Interactive Voice Response (IVR) · Front-End Development · Debugging · MySQL · Programming · Troubleshooting · Mentoring · Project Management

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer / Technical Program Lead
positions.description:
unction: Senior Implementation Manager / Technical Program Manager

Owned end-to-end implementations for 10+ enterprise clients across healthcare, banking, and government — including Aetna and Delta Dental — managing scope, milestones, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment from kickoff through go-live and hyper care
 
Built implementation methodology, playbooks, escalation frameworks, and quality standards adopted across the professional services team — improving delivery consistency and predictability across concurrent client programs
 
Led executive steering committee reviews and served as trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders — translating technical delivery status into clear business-relevant updates for VP and C-suite audiences
 
Delivered onsite end-user training at Fidelity — designing structured training materials and change management strategies that drove measurable long-term platform adoption and client self-sufficiency
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging · Front-End Development · Technical Solution Design · Interactive Voice Response (IVR) · MySQL · Design Documents · Troubleshooting · Mentoring · Computer Science · Programming · Customer Service · Customer Requirements

positions.title: Software Engineer / Technical Consultant
positions.description:
Function: Implementation Consultant / Delivery Lead

Delivered enterprise contact center and IVR implementations across banking, utilities, healthcare, and government clients — owning full-cycle delivery from requirements through production deployment and structured client handoff
 
Managed multiple simultaneous client engagements as a consultant and delivery lead — coordinating across Engineering, operations, and client stakeholders while building deep technical expertise in IVR platforms, API integrations, and enterprise systems
 
Built and integrated IVR and payment backend systems across Cisco, Avaya, REST/SOAP APIs, JDBC, and enterprise middleware — developing the cross-functional delivery and client management skills applied throughout all subsequent program leadership roles
 
Contributed to boutique consulting firm growth from founding through acquisition by Nuance Communications in 2007 — serving diverse enterprise clients across multiple industries simultaneously
